title: Tic Tac videos seen in the Pentagon before release; better videos exist

tellings.quote: tac videos that are so well known lou elizondo was behind releasing those videos i remember seeing them in the pentagon before they were released but there are more videos some are better

plain: Hal Puthoff, a physicist who has worked on government-funded research into unusual phenomena, says he watched the famous Navy "Tic Tac" videos, footage of a white oval object shaped like the mint, inside the Pentagon before they were made public in 2017. He credits former Pentagon official Lue Elizondo with getting them released, and says other videos exist, some of them better. If true, it would mean the government holds clearer footage than anything the public has seen.
